reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Massachusetts
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in court of common pleas?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario facts (question)
   ========================= */

jurisdiction(massachusetts).
focus_year(2021).

% We model the question as a single eviction case in the scenario.
case(case1).
case_type(case1, eviction).

% The court named in the question.
court(court_of_common_pleas).
court_of_common_pleas(court_of_common_pleas).

% Helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(massachusetts),
    focus_year(2021),
    case(case1),
    case_type(case1, eviction),
    court_of_common_pleas(court_of_common_pleas).

/* ===========================================
   Statute translations (as deterministic rules)
   =========================================== */

/* [1] MA Gen L ch 281  2 (2021)
   "General Laws provisions that are the same as existing statutes are construed
    as a continuation thereof, not as new enactments; references to revised and
    re-enacted provisions are construed as applying to the incorporated provisions."
*/

% statute_ch281_s2_continuation(+GeneralLawsProvision, +ExistingStatuteProvision)
% True when the General Laws provision is to be construed as a continuation of an existing statute
% because it is the same as that existing statute.
statute_ch281_s2_continuation(GeneralLawsProvision, ExistingStatuteProvision) :-
    same_as_existing_statute(GeneralLawsProvision, ExistingStatuteProvision).

% statute_ch281_s2_reference_construed_as(+OldStatuteReference, -AppliesToProvision)
% If an old statute (not repealed) references a provision that has been revised and re-enacted
% in the General Laws, the reference is construed to apply to the incorporated provision.
statute_ch281_s2_reference_construed_as(OldStatuteReference, AppliesToProvision) :-
    old_statute_not_repealed(OldStatuteReference),
    references_revised_and_reenacted_provision(OldStatuteReference, RevisedProvision),
    incorporated_in_general_laws(RevisedProvision, AppliesToProvision).

/* The statute is general/interpretive; this program includes no facts asserting that any
   eviction-related court-hearing rule is "the same as existing statutes" or that any
   unrepealed statute reference concerns eviction procedure. Therefore, these predicates
   will not yield an eviction hearing forum rule without additional facts. */

/* [2] MA Gen L ch 279  19 (2021)
   Female felony imprisonment executed at MCI Framingham; or sentencing court may impose
   jail/house of correction as provided by law for male prisoners if sentence <= 2.5 years.
*/

% Base facts about facilities.
facility(mci_framingham).
facility(jail).
facility(house_of_correction).

% statute_ch279_s19_default_facility(+Person, -Facility)
% Default execution location for a female convicted of a felony.
statute_ch279_s19_default_facility(Person, mci_framingham) :-
    person_sex(Person, female),
    convicted_of(Person, felony),
    sentence_type(Person, imprisonment).

% statute_ch279_s19_optional_local_facility(+Person, -Facility)
% Sentencing court may instead impose jail/house of correction if:
%  - it is "provided by law in the case of male prisoners" (modeled as a boolean fact),
%  - and sentence does not exceed 2.5 years.
statute_ch279_s19_optional_local_facility(Person, Facility) :-
    person_sex(Person, female),
    convicted_of(Person, felony),
    sentence_type(Person, imprisonment),
    ( Facility = jail ; Facility = house_of_correction ),
    provided_by_law_for_male_prisoners(Facility),
    sentence_years(Person, Years),
    Years =< 2.5.

/* =========================
   Legal reasoning for query
   ========================= */

% statute_provides_first_hearing_court_for_eviction(-Case, -Court)
% This predicate would succeed if any encoded statute specified where eviction cases are first heard.
% Given the provided statutes (ch 281 2 and ch 279 19), there is no such forum specification.
statute_provides_first_hearing_court_for_eviction(_Case, _Court) :-
    % There is no eviction forum rule in the provided statutes.
    fail.

% first_heard_in_court(+Case, +Court)
% Derives the "first heard in court" forum only if a statute provides it.
first_heard_in_court(Case, Court) :-
    case(Case),
    case_type(Case, eviction),
    statute_provides_first_hearing_court_for_eviction(Case, Court).

/* =========================
   Answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    first_heard_in_court(case1, court_of_common_pleas),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ first_heard_in_court(case1, court_of_common_pleas),
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in court of common pleas?
